faq.a: Haqeem is associated with Arabic. Haqeem is a transliteration of Arabic حَكِيم (Ḥakīm) 'wise, all-wise', from the root ح ك م (ḥ-k-m). The source gloss 'wise, intelligent' is a fair rendering. Same name as hakim, hakiim and hakeem.
